fields.title: Article / latest-headline record
fields.description: Raw-passthrough dataset envelope. Every record carries _input/_source/_scrapedAt (and _error/_errorDetail on failures). Article-mode records (S1-html, articleBody pulled from HTML div#post-content > section.entry since ld+json has no articleBody) carry headline/articleBody-style fields; latest-mode records (S2-rss, WordPress-style /feed) carry title/link-style fields.

_input.title: Input
_input.description: The exact input value (URL, or 'latest'/'latest:<section>') that produced this record.

_source.title: Source strategy
_source.description: Which extraction strategy emitted this record (e.g. S1-html, S2-rss).

_scrapedAt.title: Scraped at
_scrapedAt.description: UTC ISO 8601 timestamp when this record was scraped.

_error.title: Error
_error.description: Present only on failed extractions -- the error kind.

_errorDetail.title: Error detail
_errorDetail.description: Free-form diagnostic detail, present only alongside _error.

headline.title: Headline
headline.description: Article headline, from the NewsArticle ld+json block.

description.title: Description
description.description: Short article description, from the <meta name="description"> tag.

articleBody.title: Article body
articleBody.description:
Full article text, joined from direct-child

/

/

tags of each div#post-content > section.entry block (excludes promo/telegram-widget inserts, which are nested inside wrapper divs).

author.title: Author
author.description: Comma-joined byline name(s), extracted from the ld+json author Person array.

publisher.title: Publisher
publisher.description: Publisher name from the ld+json publisher object.

category.title: Category
category.description: Article-mode: section name from the ld+json BreadcrumbList's second item (best-effort, absent if not found). Latest-mode: first <category> value from the RSS item.

image.title: Image
image.description: Lead image from ld+json (article mode) or RSS <enclosure url> (latest mode).

isAccessibleForFree.title: Accessible for free
isAccessibleForFree.description: Upstream paywall metering flag from ld+json.

title.title: Title
title.description: Headline text of a latest-mode RSS item.

link.title: Link
link.description: Article URL from the RSS item.

topics.title: Topics
topics.description: List of <topic> values from the RSS item.

overview.title: Overview
overview.description: Key columns across both article and latest-headline records.
